reuse.why: Every rule change goes through the existing shared getScheduledAmount, and the approximate tolerance reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: No new copies; the old rounding-variant parameter is removed and the rule lives in one function.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is derived in api-models' toExternal, the tree's API mapping layer.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, its callers, the API list type and tests; one incidental import reordering in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One documented function with the operator as its only variation, so a future rule change is a one-line edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Server paths, the forecast, the budget template, the API model and the client balance all call getScheduledAmount with the operator.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount swaps the rangeRounding option for an op parameter and gains the isapprox branch, both part of the rule itself; client display callers that pass no op only format the entered amount.
